newsitem.title: FRANCE: Former French finance minister attacks tax rise.
newsitem.headline: Former French finance minister attacks tax rise.

text.p: Former French finance minister Jean Arthuis on Monday said he regretted that companies would bear the brunt of the additional tax measures announced by the Socialist-led government on Monday.
"I notice that the companies have to pay and I believe that it is wrong to think that there is one side for the French and one side for the companies," Arthuis told journalists.

"If one wants to fight unemployment, fight for job creation, you have to help companies. They create wealth, they create jobs," he said. "The right policy, the only policy, is to cut public spending. It is not raising taxes," he said.

Nicolas Sarkozy, former budget minister and currently spokesperson for the RPR centre-right party, said "I do not believe in raising taxes to increase revenues. I remain convinced that, taking account of the rate of taxation in France, the way to raise tax revenues is to cut the tax rate."
